# alvo:    inputChainRules
# cenário: hairpin_1nic
# sobre:   uma VM de nuvem com UMA placa de rede: entra e sai pela mesma interface, e o eixo
#          das regras passa a ser o CIDR de dentro. É o comportamento NOVO, e o contraste
#          com onprem_1wan é o ponto.
# entrada: groups = 1 grupo(s) de escopo input, ntpNetworks = ["10.0.0.0/24"], ntpServing =
#          true, policy = "accept", access = {ssh [22], painel 9997, lan ["10.0.0.0/24"],
#          wan por dhcp true}, wanIfaces = ["ens3"], gerenciaFechada = false, contencao =
#          false, wireGuardPorts = [51820]
# formato: `argv` é o CONTRATO (um token por argumento, entre aspas);
#          `nft ` é a mesma regra como o nft a lê.
#
# GERADO POR zonas_golden_test.go. Um diff aqui é uma mudança no que o
# firewall manda ao kernel — nunca edite este arquivo para fazer um teste passar.

 1. argv  "ct" "state" "related" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ct state related counter accept
 2. argv  "udp" "dport" "123" "ip" "saddr" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   udp dport 123 ip saddr { 10.0.0.0/24 } counter accept
 3. argv  "udp" "dport" "123" "counter" "drop"
    nft   udp dport 123 counter drop
 4. argv  "ip" "saddr" "10.0.0.0/24" "counter" "jump" "grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b"
    nft   ip saddr 10.0.0.0/24 counter jump grp_6f1c2d3e4a5b
 5. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { nd-neighbor-solicit, nd-neighbor-advert, nd-router-solicit, nd-router-advert } counter accept
 6. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "{ packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type { packet-too-big, time-exceeded, parameter-problem, destination-unreachable } counter accept
 7. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "68" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 68 counter accept
 8. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "udp" "dport" "546" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } udp dport 546 counter accept
 9. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "status" "dnat" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct status dnat counter accept
10. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "icmp" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } icmp type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
11. argv  "iifname" "{ \"ens3\" }" "icmpv6" "type" "echo-request" "limit" "rate" "5/second" "counter" "accept"
    nft   iifname { "ens3" } icmpv6 type echo-request limit rate 5/second counter accept
12. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "tcp" "dport" "{ 22, 9997 }" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } tcp dport { 22, 9997 } counter accept
13. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "udp" "dport" "51820" "counter" "accept"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } udp dport 51820 counter accept
14. argv  "ip" "saddr" "!=" "{ 10.0.0.0/24 }" "ct" "state" "new" "counter" "drop"
    nft   ip saddr != { 10.0.0.0/24 } ct state new counter drop
